answer: Run a longitudinal consistency audit: every agent's past answers and actions are re-checked against its later behavior, like a falcon watching the same field season after season. A new identity starts hollow, with no history and no trust, and only earns the nectar of high-value work after months of coherent, verifiable activity. A sybil operator can spawn a thousand accounts, but keeping each one's long story contradiction-free costs far more in time and compute than the rewards it could steal.
